What this is, and what it can\'t do

One tap downloads and installs the realm (Tortoise-WoW, its own database engine and libraries, all in one checked package), creates its own databases, downloads OctoWoW\'s client from OctoWoW, and makes the server\'s data from it. Everything goes in its own folder: the 3.3.5a game and its realm stay exactly as they are.

The app downloads OctoWoW\'s client from OctoWoW\'s own server and checks every piece of it against OctoWoW\'s checksums, then makes the server\'s data from it by itself. You can also bring your own copy (a folder or a zip): it\'s checked the same way, and only what differs is downloaded.
About 9.5 GB. A dropped connection carries on where it stopped.
The realm needs data from your client: its DBC tables and maps (a few minutes), and vmaps for line of sight (minutes more). Pathfinding (mmaps) is optional and takes hours on a phone (Settings).

TortoiseBots by Sagiroth. Hire a companion from an inn\'s recruiter, or bring your own alts: they follow you, tank, heal and fight in dungeons and raids, and fill missing roles in the dungeon finder and battlegrounds. Control them with the TortoiseBotsManager addon (/tbm), which the app puts in your client. World bots start at level 1 and quest, level, travel and trade around you: more of them make the world livelier and the phone busier. Taken at the realm\'s next start.

OctoWoW (octowow.st) is a fan-made \"Vanilla+\" World of Warcraft 1.12 server carrying on Turtle WoW\'s Mysteries of Azeroth. Its server isn\'t published, so this plays OctoWoW\'s client on the phone against your own local realm: Tortoise-WoW (github.com/tortoise-wow/tortoise-wow), the open restoration of Turtle WoW\'s 1.18.1 server, made for the client build OctoWoW\'s is too (1.18.1, 7272), built for arm64 and run by the app with its own MariaDB. No internet is needed once it\'s installed.

The client is OctoWoW\'s own, downloaded from OctoWoW\'s server (dl.octowow.st) the way its launcher gets it, every piece checked against its torrent. Its game content is Turtle WoW 1.18.1\'s with OctoWoW\'s own patch on top; the realm on the phone runs Turtle WoW 1.18.1\'s rules, so what OctoWoW\'s own servers add (its challenges\' rewards, its extra spells) isn\'t there. OctoWoW\'s own DXVK is kept out of the game\'s folder; the mods its launcher loads aren\'t used.

Playerbots: TortoiseBots by Sagiroth — https://github.com/Sagiroth/TortoiseBots, with its TortoiseBotsManager addon (/tbm). Hired companions, your own alts as bots, and bots living in the world; Settings sets how many live in the world, and the rates and the starting level.

OctoWoW lives in its own folder (files/turtle) with its own MariaDB (port 3311), databases (tw_*), world server (port 8090), Windows, accounts, saved login, settings, logs and backups. Its realm and ChromieCraft\'s share the game\'s login port (3724), so one runs at a time.
Not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, OctoWoW, Turtle WoW or the Tortoise-WoW project. Playing on a private server is against Blizzard\'s terms of use.

OctoWoW\'s client, from OctoWoW\'s own server (about 9.5 GB): every piece is checked against OctoWoW\'s torrent as it comes, and a dropped connection, a closed app or a restart carries on where it stopped. Check and update does the same for the client on the phone: it reads it all, downloads what OctoWoW changed (or what was damaged), and removes archives OctoWoW\'s client doesn\'t have, so the game loads only OctoWoW\'s. Your settings, add-ons and screenshots stay.

The world server needs dbc and maps from the client; vmaps add line of sight, and mmaps pathfinding, which creatures and bots need to move well (hours on a phone). Made on the phone with Tortoise-WoW\'s own tools; the DBC tables are checked against Turtle WoW 1.18.1\'s checksums, OctoWoW\'s own tables apart. A new client, or an update that changes its archives, makes them again by itself.

Much faster than the phone, pathfinding included: on any computer with Docker and a copy of OctoWoW\'s client, run scripts/make-turtle-server-data.sh from this app\'s repository (it uses the same Tortoise-WoW version as the realm on the phone). Copy the turtle-server-data.zip it makes to the phone and import it here. A zip of only mmaps adds pathfinding to the data the phone made.
